articles.headline: Nvidia joins funding push to scale AI infrastructure beyond $500 billion
articles.summary: Nvidia announced financing partnerships with major asset managers to help raise more than $500 billion in third-party capital for AI infrastructure. For businesses, this signals continued heavy investment in AI capacity, with likely effects on cloud pricing, GPU supply, and the cost of scaling AI workloads.

articles.headline: China adds European entities to export-control list
articles.summary: China expanded export controls to 14 European entities, restricting dual-use shipments such as rare earths and permanent magnets without special authorization. That increases supply-chain risk for manufacturers and hardware buyers, especially those dependent on critical minerals, magnets, and industrial inputs tied to electronics and defense supply chains.

articles.headline: OpenAI tightens controls after cybersecurity risk concerns in upcoming model
articles.summary: OpenAI reportedly flagged a possible critical cybersecurity risk in an upcoming model and tightened controls around its release. For enterprises adopting frontier AI, this reinforces the need for vendor due diligence, restricted deployments, and internal governance before rolling out new models into sensitive workflows.
